description: GotoTask is the one edge node in an otherwise edge-free Sequence workflow: a backward jump. Sits LAST in ProcessDef::Activity, renders no form, and — like Parallel — carries zero Permission nodes.
notes: The back-ref is bidirectional: the JUMP TARGET gets Goto::Activity:[<goto id>] even though the GotoTask itself is the one carrying the scalar Goto:<target id> forward-pointer.
Carries no Permission / Activity::Permission — exclude every GotoTask (and every Parallel) from any per-step permission-matrix count; the builder writes none for either.

This shape shows the condition wiring point (Activity::Expression would attach here) but leaves the condition itself to expression_goto_condition.json — a bare Goto with no Activity::Expression loops forever, it is never a no-op default.
Name is conventionally "Goto-<target activity name>" — cosmetic, but every UI-built one observed followed it.
